data.name: Azzami
data.gender_notes: Azzami is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'azza', meaning to strengthen, support, or help. In Islamic context, the name Azzami signifies someone who is a source of strength and support for others. The name Azzami carries the meaning “Supporting, Helping” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azzami usually hope their child will grow to embody supporting, helping and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the spirit of support and help in times of need.
data.etymology: Azzami belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Supporting, Helping.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azzami total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
